description:
We are seeking a motivated, high-energy Junior Business Developer with 2-4 years of experience to join our Intercompany Sales Excellence team. This role is designed for a professional ready to take the next step in their sales career, transitioning from lead generation into full-cycle business development. You will be responsible for identifying new market opportunities, building relationships with potential clients, and driving revenue growth through strategic outreach and partnership building.
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Pipeline Generation:  Identify, research, and map out prospective clients via incoming emails, cold calling, and personalized email outreach.
 Outreach & Engagement:  Manage a high volume of outbound activities to qualified leads, pitching our solutions and booking discovery meetings.
 Client Discovery:  Conduct initial discovery calls to understand prospect pain points, budget, and purchasing authority, mapping them to our solutions.
 Sales Process Management:  Navigate the early stages of the sales cycle, leverage global network of capabilities to provide solutions to clients, maintaining accurate, up-to-date records in our CRM – Scoro.  
 Collaboration:  Partner with marketing to refine outreach messaging and work closely with Account Executives to ensure smooth handoffs of qualified opportunities.
 Targets:  Meet or exceed monthly/quarterly targets for meetings booked, qualified opportunities, and revenue closed.
 
 Experience:  2–4 years of experience in business development, sales development, or account management (ideally in B2B tech or professional services).
 Proven Track Record:  Demonstrated ability to meet or exceed targets.
 Communication Skills:  Exceptional verbal and written communication, with the ability to build rapport quickly over phone and email.
 Tools:  Proficiency with CRM software and Microsoft Office
 Education:  Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).
 Mindset:  A proactive, "hunter" mentality, with the resilience to handle rejection and the curiosity to learn new industries.
 
 Compensation: 
 Salary: $75k + Monthly Commission
 What we offer: 
 Excellent full time benefits including comprehensive medical coverage, dental, and vision options
 Life and disability insurance
 401(k) with company match
 Paid vacation and holidays
 
 Eurofins USA Consumer Product Testing is a Disabled and Veteran Equal Employment Opportunity employer.
